Private Sub Form_Load()
    Dim cn As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim li As Object

    ListView1.View = lvwReport

    Do While Not rs.EOF
        Set li = ListView1.ListItems.Add , , rs("Name")

        rs.MoveNext
    Loop

    rs.Close
    cn.Close
End Sub
